name: landmine
description: Finds the open GitHub issues filed against the exact npm and PyPI versions a project pins, checks that each names that version, and returns the bug with the best workaround from the issue thread. Tools: landmine_lookup, landmine_check, landmine_search, landmine_list (the last two read the index that `npx landmines scan` writes).

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token for landmine_lookup (no scopes needed). Without it, the GitHub CLI's login is used.
